# AAPI
> OpenAI-compatible multi-model API gateway. One API key. Official list prices.

- Site: https://aapi.ai
- Pricing: https://aapi.ai/pricing
- Base URL: https://aapi.ai/v1
- Docs repo: https://github.com/cozcc/aapi
- Public pricing JSON: https://aapi.ai/api/pricing

Do not invent admin APIs. Use only documented OpenAI-compatible chat completions against the Base URL with a user API key.
